title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Paying One Bill 😂 When My ADHD Gets Me in Trouble #shorts
desc:
When my ADHD gets me in trouble: a two-minute bill, an all-day job.

Opened the laptop to pay one bill. 40 tabs later, still not paid. Late fee: $35. 😂 What's YOUR two-minute task that takes all day? 👇

Tip: turn on autopay for anything with a due date.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny
tags: when my adhd gets me in trouble
how to manage money with adhd
what it's like to have adhd

beats.say: Here's how a normal person pays a bill. Open it. Pay it. Close it.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. The light bill. Two minutes. Easy.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I need my password. Forgot it. Reset it. Need a new password. Not that one, I used that one.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: While I'm on here, let me check my bank. Ooh, what's this charge? Oh, a streaming thing I forgot about.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Is it worth canceling? Let me read every review of every streaming service ever made.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: It's dark outside. I know everything about streaming. And the light bill is still open.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: The light bill. Still not paid.

beats.say: And now there's a late fee. Thirty five dollars. For a two minute bill.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. Boring tasks with no deadline today get pushed behind anything more interesting. So turn on autopay for anything with a due date, and let the robot remember for you.
beats.cap2: Tip: autopay anything with a due date.

beats.say: What's your two minute task that takes all day? Tell me in the comments.
